title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: federated Copilot connectors read third-party data in real time
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing and documented governance controls are supported. Minor corrections should complete the staging and connection paths, identify the settings used by the Graph calls, and acknowledge conflicting Microsoft documentation about write actions, custom connectors and TCM cloud availability.
